method: University of Bath official page "Tuition fees for undergraduate students starting in 2027" (bath.ac.uk/corporate-information/...), plus /topics/tuition-fees/ index and the 2027 course pages (course-page "Fees and funding" sections could not be read via the fetch tool; they link to the fee page above). fees.yearEvidence: The tuition fees you must pay if you are starting an undergraduate course in the 2027/28 academic year.
